brief: Nasdaq 100 futures are sharply lower into the open after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's reported resignation amid board turmoil, with Nvidia down roughly 7% premarket and dragging AI and chip names; VIX is up about 6.6% near 18.6. The 10-year yield is back near 5% after Wednesday's bond-market holiday and the dollar is flat. Fed speakers through the afternoon (Goolsbee 11:15, Daly 1:10) come amid pricing for a possible December hike. Key risk for the full session is further Nvidia leadership headlines driving two-way volatility; overnight high/low were not available.
